payload.goal: Gate every stable sofar release on a held-out eval: the full sofar-evaluator chain (3 reps) runs on the final RC before promotion to latest, and stable ships only code that RC was scored on (version strings aside).

plan.goal: Gate every stable sofar release on a held-out eval: the full sofar-evaluator chain (3 reps) runs on the final RC before promotion to latest, and stable ships only code that RC was scored on (version strings aside).

tasks.title: Write the gate procedure: how an RC is declared final, the run (sofar-evaluator, chain A S1–S9, 3 reps, model pinned), pass/fail against the standing score with self-improve D25's noise tolerance, and the re-cut loop on failure
Stable-vs-RC diff check: a script that fails when the stable commit differs from the evaluated RC tag in anything but version strings
Record the baseline standing score on the current stable (3 reps), so the first gated RC has something to be compared against
Launch wrapper: run the gate on an RC tag from a launchd job (never an agent's Bash tool), writing the verdict where the release procedure reads it
Add the gate and the diff check to the release procedure (repo-memory-capture M1) as steps before promotion to latest
First gated stable release, end to end

payload.because: The eval costs hours, so only the RC that becomes stable needs it. Gating before latest keeps regressions off users. 0.34.0 added packaging changes over rc.5, so the diff check is what makes the score cover the shipped code.
payload.chose: Gate stable releases with the full sofar-evaluator chain (S1-S9, 3 reps, about 2.5 h on Haiku) run once, on the final RC only. Earlier RCs get CI only. Stable must differ from that RC in version strings alone, else cut another RC.
payload.over: Evaluating every RC of a version (about 2.5 h each); evaluating after the release (finds regressions users already have); an S1-only smoke as the gate (misses handoff regressions).

payload.rule: Run the full eval on the last RC before finalising the stable release, not on every RC of the same version; ship stable only if it differs from that RC in version strings alone.
